source: Generated premium Lost Site Expedition Egypt ground-contact kit, 2026-06-02. Chroma-key source was converted to alpha for runtime use. Extended 2026-07-08 with four transparent premium sand-buildup overlays for prop burial.
mappingNote: Transparent visual-only structure-grounding pieces for Egypt Journey buildings and thresholds. These regions are contact lips, rubble footings, stair-base support pieces, sediment ribbons, pebble scatter, wind-banked prop skirts, and side-biased sand heaps; they do not define collision, gameplay, or atmosphere haze.

premiumLongSandLip.purpose: wide premium sand and stone lip for embedding large Egypt structures

premiumShortSandLip.purpose: shorter sand lip for secondary thresholds and small structure bases

premiumDoorThresholdBuildup.purpose: doorway threshold sand buildup with broken stone edges

premiumBrokenMasonryFooting.purpose: broken sandstone masonry footing for raised building bases

premiumRubbleContactShadow.purpose: dark rubble contact shadow with pebble scatter

premiumHalfBuriedStairSupport.purpose: half-buried stair and slab support for climb bases

premiumCarvedStoneEdge.purpose: broken carved stone edge for ornate Egypt thresholds

premiumSmallStoneScatter.purpose: small detached stone-chip scatter for local edge variation

premiumLowSedimentRibbon.purpose: low windblown sediment ribbon without haze

premiumRubbleMoundBlend.purpose: larger rubble mound blend for heavy base grounding

premiumWindBankedPropSkirt.purpose: wide wind-banked sand skirt to tuck the base of props into the ground

premiumLeftBuriedSandHeap.purpose: left-heavy sand heap climbing over a prop base

premiumRightBuriedSandHeap.purpose: right-heavy sand heap climbing over a prop base

premiumThinSandCoverRibbon.purpose: thin low sand cover ribbon for small props and thresholds
